note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Only three candidates were nominated for the fourteen divisions; all the other outgoing members were automatically returned (deemed re-elected) and there were no contests. The members deemed re-elected are added with their divisions inferred from the 1930 return, placed on the council by the new council's annual meeting (30 May 1933) or, for Ballycoshone, Clonduff, Crobane and Rathfriland North and South, by meeting reports of June-October 1933 (round2-down, 7 Nov 2026). No nomination was received; the retiring member was deemed re-elected, not a co-option. Division inferred from Newry Reporter, 3 May 1930, p. 2 and Newry Telegraph, 3 May 1930, p. 2 (S. Peters, Rathfriland South); the Newry Reporter, 1933-09-30, p. 5 names the member as sitting on the council about four months into the term. Not in the first-meeting attendance list (30 May 1933). No co-option, vacancy or by-election report for the division was found June-November 1933. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
